analysis.headline: Energy and Healthcare Hold Leadership as Geographic and Sector Rotations Diverge Across Horizons
analysis.executive_summary: Energy and Healthcare exhibit sustained relative leadership across domestic and global sectors, supported by 63-bar rotation score highs in Oil Services (OIH) and Global Energy (IXC). Meanwhile, broad equity markets show mixed relative strength across short- and long-term horizons, with notable divergences inside Consumer Discretionary and Real Estate sectors. Trend transitions remain constrained by the 3-observation confirmation rule, keeping several pending raw moves under observation.

emerging_rotations.title: Oil Services Reaches 63-Bar Score High
emerging_rotations.explanation: Confirmed in an EMERGING trend state with a rotation score of 80.0, which marks a 63-bar score high. The fund registered a 20-bar score improvement of 36.85 and a 5-bar score change of 21.48, supported by positive relative strength across both horizons (20-bar relative strength of +11.07 percentage points and 63-bar relative strength of +0.66 percentage points).

emerging_rotations.title: International Small Cap Relative Strength Gains Ground
emerging_rotations.explanation: Confirmed in an EMERGING trend state with a rotation score of 67.86 after a 20-bar score change of +41.43. VSS exhibits mixed relative strength across horizons, with a positive 20-bar relative strength of +2.72 percentage points alongside a negative 63-bar relative strength of -1.22 percentage points.

accelerating_rotations.title: Germany Maintains Confirmed Accelerating State
accelerating_rotations.explanation: Confirmed in an ACCELERATING trend state with a current rotation score of 64.24, backed by a 5-bar score change of 8.75 and a 20-bar score change of 3.02. EWG shows conflicting relative strength across horizons, with 20-bar relative strength at -0.34 percentage points and 63-bar relative strength at +2.03 percentage points. Note that raw_state is currently NEUTRAL with 1/3 confirmation observations.

persistent_leaders.title: U.S. Energy Leads Cross-Sectional Sector Rankings
persistent_leaders.explanation: Maintains a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state for 6 observations with a group-topping rotation score of 88.18. It shows strong alignment across timeframes with a 20-bar score change of 22.73, 20-bar relative strength of +7.56 percentage points, and 63-bar relative strength of +11.05 percentage points.

persistent_leaders.title: Pharmaceuticals Sustains Long-Term Sector Leadership
persistent_leaders.explanation: Holds a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER trend state with an age of 44 observations and a rotation score of 86.25. While 20-bar relative strength stands at +2.26 percentage points, longer-horizon strength remains prominent with a 63-bar relative strength of +21.79 percentage points.

reaccelerating_rotations.title: New Zealand Confirmed Reaccelerating
reaccelerating_rotations.explanation: Confirmed in a REACCELERATING state with a score of 63.48 and confirmed state age of 8 observations. ENZL presents divergent relative strength across horizons, citing 20-bar relative strength of -0.20 percentage points and 63-bar relative strength of +2.95 percentage points. Its raw_state reflects a pending WEAKENING condition (1/3 confirmation days).

weakening_rotations.explanation: Confirmed in a WEAKENING state with a rotation score of 23.54, which represents a 63-bar score low. It experienced a 20-bar score decline of -31.27 and negative relative strength across both horizons (-8.44 percentage points over 20 bars and -1.99 percentage points over 63 bars). Today's raw_state shows a pending ROTATION_OUT condition (1/3 days).

weakening_rotations.title: Retail Displays Deteriorating Short-Term Score
weakening_rotations.explanation: Confirmed in a WEAKENING trend state with a rotation score of 30.42 following a 20-bar score change of -34.77 and a 5-bar score change of -17.92. Relative strength is split between horizons, registering -7.10 percentage points over 20 bars and +2.18 percentage points over 63 bars.

rotation_out.title: Utilities Confirmed in Rotation Out State
rotation_out.explanation: Holds a confirmed ROTATION_OUT state with a score of 40.45 and negative relative strength on both horizons (-6.04 percentage points over 20 bars and -2.78 percentage points over 63 bars). Recent short-term bounce is reflected in a 5-bar score change of +17.73 and a pending raw state of NEUTRAL (2/3 observations).

rotation_out.title: Qatar Stays Confirmed in Rotation Out
rotation_out.explanation: Maintains a confirmed ROTATION_OUT trend state with a score of 38.18 and a confirmed age of 9 observations. Relative strength remains negative on both timeframes, at -3.63 percentage points over 20 bars and -7.27 percentage points over 63 bars, despite a short-term 5-bar score change of +14.28 (raw_state NEUTRAL pending 2/3 days).

geographic_rotations.title: Turkey Tops Country ETF Score Improvements
geographic_rotations.explanation: Confirmed in a PERSISTENT_LEADER trend state with a rotation score of 87.12, ranking 1st out of 33 country ETFs. TUR registered a 20-bar score increase of 52.97 and a 5-bar score change of 21.76, accompanied by positive relative strength of +4.06 percentage points over 20 bars and +3.30 percentage points over 63 bars.

geographic_rotations.title: South Africa Demonstrates Sustained Country Strength
geographic_rotations.explanation: Confirmed as a PERSISTENT_LEADER with a score of 81.14 (rank 4 of 33). EZA achieved a 20-bar score improvement of 50.77 and exhibits positive relative strength on both horizons (+7.29 percentage points over 20 bars and +4.81 percentage points over 63 bars).

pair_relationships.title: Large-Cap Growth vs Value Divergence
pair_relationships.explanation: Paired against U.S. Large-Cap Value (IWD). IWF is confirmed in a NEUTRAL state with a score of 46.04, while IWD is confirmed in a WEAKENING state with a score of 73.72. The pair relationship displays mixed horizon spreads: IWF leads IWD over 20 bars with a pair spread of +0.47 percentage points, but lags over 63 bars with a pair spread of -13.15 percentage points.

pair_relationships.title: S&P 500 Equal Weight vs Cap Weight Spread
pair_relationships.explanation: Paired against S&P 500 cap-weighted benchmark (SPY). RSP is confirmed in a WEAKENING state with a rotation score of 58.48 (raw_state NEUTRAL pending 2/3 days). The pair signal is mixed across horizons, with RSP lagging SPY over 20 bars (pair spread -0.19 percentage points) while leading over 63 bars (pair spread +3.89 percentage points).

cross_market_confirmations: Energy leadership is confirmed across domestic sector (XLE, score 88.18), global sector (IXC, score 88.0 on a 63-bar score high), and US industry groups (OIH, score 80.0 on a 63-bar score high).

Health Care strength is confirmed across US broad sector (XLV, score 83.18), Global Health Care (IXJ, score 80.0), and sub-industries Pharmaceuticals (XPH, score 86.25) and Biotech (XBI, score 83.12).
risks_or_conflicts: Consumer Discretionary exhibits material internal sector divergence between improving Homebuilders (XHB, 20-bar score change of +15.21) and weakening Retail (XRT, 20-bar score change of -34.77).

Real Estate displays notable internal sector divergence between improving Mortgage Real Estate (REM, 20-bar score change of +21.32) and weakening broad Real Estate (XLRE, 20-bar score change of -20.0).
analysis.methodology_note: Interpretation uses Python-confirmed trend states that require 3 consecutive daily observations before a new raw condition becomes canonical. Raw conditions remain available as pending early warnings. Evidence also uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, persistence metrics, and Python-calculated attention flags including 63-bar rotation-score extrema and material cross-market conflicts. ETF volume and CMF are treated as market-participation indicators, not fund-flow data.
